title: Find out why a picture of an open menu on a video comes back black behind the menu
goal: When a walk photographs a panel menu open over a video document, the picture shows the menu floating on black instead of over the app, so an audit cannot show what a person sees. Pictures of menus over an image document, and every other picture in the same walks, come out whole. Find out why and make the picture show the window.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-29 around 01:00, screen unlocked, probe Screen Recording granted, person away. `Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/video-panel-order-walk.json` then sampling 25 points of /tmp/photonz-playtest/video-panel-order-walk/2-the-speed-dropdown-sc.png: 24 of 25 pure black. Same on main with the dropdown change stashed (baseline check: 24 of 25 black), and on between-the-keys-walk 2-curve-menu-sc.png (25 of 25). zoom-readout-double-click-walk 3-zoom-menu-sc.png on an image document: 0 of 25 black. At about 23:50 on 2026-09-28 the same captions walk photographed its open Show menu over the whole window, so it comes and goes. SCShareableContent listed both windows (menu layer 101, editor layer -1, both isOnScreen true) and a filter by the whole app was still black; a whole-display capture showed another app's browser window over the probe's spot (walk windows sit one level under other apps). Suspect: the covered editor window of a video document is not drawn while the menu tracks. PlaytestPanelMenu.capture.
acceptance: A panelMenu step with a shot on a video document photographs the editor window behind the open menu
zoom-readout-double-click-walk still photographs its zoom menu over the window

log.note: triage 2026-09-29: retagged design-system -> video-editing: the black pictures are in audits of video panel menus, the focus epic

cause: a recording opened by a walk keeps its editor window at alpha 0 until a picture asks for it. rightClick showed the window for its menu picture (so 3-the-clip-menu in the same walk was whole); panelMenu and the menu bar path did not, so the menu floated on an empty (transparent) plate. Not about video rendering at all: image documents are revealed on open, which is why the zoom menu was fine.

Fixed in fd1a578c: panelMenu, menu bar and right-click menu pictures share showForMenuPicture/hideAfterMenuPicture in PlaytestHarness.swift, which shows a still-hidden window for the picture and hides it after. Verified: video-panel-order-walk 2-the-speed-dropdown went from 24/25 empty samples to 0/25 and reads as the whole editor; between-the-keys-walk 2-curve-menu and every-dropdown-opens-on-a-click-walk 2-show-open 0/25; zoom-readout-double-click-walk 3-zoom-menu still whole; menu-checkmarks-walk passes; Scripts/test.sh 10570 tests green.
